scheduleName.description: Name of the location's schedule which determines when the sequential ring is in effect.

scheduleType.description:
The type of schedule.
 * `holidays` - The Schedule is of type `holidays`.
 * `businessHours` - The Schedule is of type `businessHours`.

scheduleLevel.description:
This indicates the level of the schedule specified by `scheduleName`.
 * `GROUP` - The Schedule specified is of `GROUP` level.

callsFrom.description:
This indicates if criteria are applicable for calls from any phone number or selected phone numbers.
 * `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS` - Sequential ring criteria only apply for selected incoming numbers.
 * `ANY_PHONE_NUMBER` - Sequential ring criteria apply for any incoming number.

anonymousCallersEnabled.description: When `true` incoming calls from private numbers are allowed. This is only applicable when `callsFrom` is set to `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

unavailableCallersEnabled.description: When `true` incoming calls from unavailable numbers are allowed. This is only applicable when `callsFrom` is set to `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

phoneNumbers.description: When callsFrom is set to `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`, indicates a list of incoming phone numbers for which the criteria apply.

ringEnabled.description: When set to `true` sequential ringing is enabled for calls that meet the current criteria. Criteria with `ringEnabled` set to `false` take priority.
